Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service or operating Kubernetes on Azure. Experience with Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, admission control, scheduling, autoscaling, service mesh, or multi-cluster networking. Experience improving reliability through SLOs, observability, incident response, automation, and operational readiness practices.
